marks.gloss_en: מאי טעמא, לאו משום דזהיר ולא נגע?
one who eats by another's feeding requires washing the hands
לא, דזריז קדים ומשי ידיה מעיקרא -- he was diligent and had washed beforehand
מכל מקום הא קאמר: אלא אם כן יודע שנטל ידיו -- the one fed must have washed
שאני שמש דטריד -- an attendant is different, for he is busy
תא שמע: אשה מדיחה את ידה אחת במים ונותנת פת לבנה קטן... וגזרו עליו שיאכיל בשתי ידיו -- the feeder washes
RSbG: a woman rinses one hand in water and gives bread to her small son
התם משום שיבתא -- there it is because of Shivta, not because of feeding
Abaye: there, it is because of Shivta
תא שמע: ...לא מיסתייה דלא גמיר, מימחא נמי מחי -- the feeder need not wash

Shmuel's father found Shmuel crying: my teacher struck me, for he said: you feed my son and did not wash your hands. -- And why did you not wash? -- he eats, and I should wash?! -- his father: is it not enough that he did not learn, he strikes as well!
אשתמיטתיה הא דאמר רב תחליפא בר אבימי אמר שמואל: התירו מפה לאוכלי תרומה... ורבי אמי ורבי אסי כהנים הוו -- it escaped R' Zeira that the cloth is permitted to teruma eaters, and they were priests
Shmuel: they permitted a cloth to those who eat teruma
Rav: the attendant does not bless each slice; R' Yochanan: he does
לא קשיא: הא דאיכא אדם חשוב, הא דליכא אדם חשוב (= p_rp_ika_adam_chashuv, p_rp_leika_adam_chashuv)
Rav Pappa: this [Rav's] is where there is an important person
והלכתא: אוכל מחמת מאכיל צריך נטילת ידים
מאכיל אינו צריך נטילת ידים
Rav: my mind is short with me [the reason I eat with a cloth]
R' Zeira to R' Ami and R' Asi, found eating with worn skins: two great men like you -- should you err about Rav and Shmuel? he said 'my mind is short with me'!
Rav: a person should not put a slice into the attendant's mouth unless he knows that he washed his hands
the baraita: a person should not give a slice to the attendant, whether the cup is in his hand or in the host's hand, lest a mishap occur at the meal
one who feeds [another] requires washing the hands
תניא נמי הכי: two guests who lodged at one inn, this one from the north and that one from the south ... eat on one table and need not be concerned; and they forbade only [like] one parcel

RSbG (baraita): two guests who lodged at one inn, this one come from the north and that one from the south, this one come with his piece [of meat] and that one with his cheese, eat on one table, this one meat and that one cheese, and need not be concerned
יאמרו כל הסריקין אסורין וסריקי ביתוס מותרין?! -- Abaye answers the brothers question from the Syrian cakes of Baitos
Abaye (answering Rav Yeimar): two brothers who are particular with each other -- [forbidden]; stated only through his rhetorical Syrian-cakes question

ולטעמיך: what R' Asi said R' Yochanan said -- one who has only one shirt may launder it on chol hamoed -- [there too] shall they say: all the decorated cakes are forbidden and the decorated cakes of Baitos permitted?
R' Yochanan: one who has only one shirt is permitted to launder it on the intermediate days of the festival
RSbG (mishna): two guests eat on one table, this one meat and that one cheese, and they need not be concerned
Shmuel: they taught this only when they do not know each other
RSbG (baraita): and they forbade only in one parcel
וכי נוגע זה בזה מאי הוי? צונן בצונן הוא! -- and if they touch each other, what of it? it is cold with cold!
אמר אביי: נהי דקליפה לא בעי, הדחה מי לא בעי? -- granted no peeling is required, is rinsing not required?
Abaye: granted that [cold meat and cheese that touched] do not require peeling
